item.title: 黄仁勋辞去英伟达 CEO，特朗普推荐库克接任
item.guid: 黄仁勋辞去英伟达-CEO，特朗普推荐库克接任
item.description:
Nvidia suddenly announced last night that co-founder Jensen Huang has resigned from his positions as company president, CEO, and director, effective immediately. 英伟达昨晚突然宣布，联合创始人黄仁勋辞去公司总裁、CEO 及董事职务，即刻生效。

Documents filed by the company with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) show that the board of directors accepted the resignation on November 11 local time and appointed current Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as interim CEO. 公司向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交的文件显示，董事会已于当地时间 11 月 11 日接受辞呈，并任命现任首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯（Colette Kress）出任临时 CEO。

Concurrently, Harvey Jones, who has served on Nvidia's board since 1993, has been appointed as the company's first Board Chairman. Jones previously served as CEO and Executive Chairman of Synopsys, a chip design software company. The board has initiated a formal CEO selection process and will consider both internal and external candidates. 与此同时，自 1993 年起担任英伟达董事的哈维·琼斯（Harvey Jones）获任公司首任董事会主席。琼斯曾担任芯片设计软件企业新思科技（Synopsys）的 CEO 及执行董事长。董事会已启动正式 CEO 遴选程序，将同时考虑内部和外部候选人。

According to The Verge, Kress acknowledged in an internal email to employees that the company has recently experienced an "exceptionally difficult period" and stated that management would provide further details on future arrangements in the coming days. Nvidia plans to hold an all-hands meeting on November 18 local time. 据 The Verge 报道，克雷斯在发给员工的内部邮件中承认，公司近期经历了一段「异常艰难的时期」，并表示管理层将在未来几天进一步说明后续安排。英伟达计划于当地时间 11 月 18 日举行全员大会。

Jones emphasized that the company's operations, customer commitments, and product roadmap will proceed as planned. Nvidia will still announce its Q3 FY2027 results and hold an earnings call on November 17. 琼斯则强调，公司运营、客户承诺和产品路线图将按原计划推进。英伟达仍将于 11 月 17 日公布 2027 财年第三季度业绩，并举行财报电话会议。

Jensen Huang has served as Nvidia's CEO since co-founding the company in 1993. His departure marks the end of his 33-year leadership career. 黄仁勋自 1993 年参与创立英伟达以来，一直担任公司 CEO。此次离任结束了其长达 33 年的领导生涯。

According to Reuters, Jensen Huang still holds approximately 3.61% of Nvidia's shares, making him the fourth-largest shareholder and the largest individual shareholder. 据路透社报道，黄仁勋目前仍持有英伟达约 3.61% 的股份，是英伟达第四大股东， 也是最大的个人股东。

🔗 Related reading: Breaking! Jensen Huang Resigns as CEO, Nvidia Welcomes Historic Leadership Change 🔗 相关阅读： 突发！黄仁勋辞任 CEO，英伟达迎来历史性换帅

item.title: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，接入搜索和免费开发工具
item.guid: 谷歌发布-Gemini-4-Hydrogen，接入搜索和免费开发工具
item.description:
Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen on November 12, designed for everyday programming and multi-step tasks requiring repeated tool calls. The model is rolling out globally: Google Search is open to all users, free users of the Gemini app will use it when Hydrogen is automatically selected by the system, and developers can try it at various levels in Google AI Studio. 谷歌 11 月 12 日发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，面向日常编程和需要反复调用工具的多步任务。模型开始在全球推送：Google 搜索向所有用户开放，Gemini 应用的免费用户会在系统自动选中 Hydrogen 时用到它，开发者可以在 Google AI Studio 的各个层级试用。

Hydrogen offers four inference intensity levels: low, medium, high, and highest, with high being the default. Google states that on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, the default level scored 51 points, higher than the 50 points of the Argon series; the highest level reached 54 points. In Google Antigravity, the newly launched Orchestrator can also switch between Carbon and Hydrogen within the same task, handling complex judgments and execution steps, respectively. Hydrogen 提供低、中、高和最高四档推理强度，默认使用高档。谷歌称，在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上，默认档得到 51 分，高于同系列 Argon 的 50 分；最高档达到 54 分。在 Google Antigravity 中，新推出的 Orchestrator 还能在同一个任务里切换 Carbon 和 Hydrogen，分别处理复杂判断和执行步骤。

The Gemini API is uniformly priced within a 1 million token context window: $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. In Antigravity, using Hydrogen is available to Google AI Pro and Ultra paid subscribers. Gemini API 在 100 万 token 的上下文窗口内统一计价：每百万输入 token 1.50 美元，每百万输出 token 7.50 美元。Antigravity 中使用 Hydrogen 面向 Google AI Pro 和 Ultra 付费订阅者。

🔗 Related reading: Just now, the new Gemini 4 model is here again, finally available to everyone 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，Gemini 4 新模型叒来了，终于人人可用

item.title: 微信「看一看」小范围测试短剧入口，可找回最近看过的剧
item.guid: 微信「看一看」小范围测试短剧入口，可找回最近看过的剧
item.description:
According to a report by "KeChuangBan Daily", sources close to Tencent revealed that WeChat "Look" is testing a short drama entry point on a small scale, allowing users to view recently watched short dramas from this entry. The source stated that the test also aims to make it easier for users to find works of interest and give creators' content more exposure. 据《科创板日报》报道，接近腾讯的知情人士透露，微信「看一看」正在小范围测试短剧入口，用户可以从入口查看最近看过的短剧。该人士称，测试也希望让用户更容易找到感兴趣的作品，让创作者的内容获得更多曝光。

In October this year, the "Green Bubble Short Drama" free mini-program was launched in the WeChat ecosystem. According to previous tests by "Yangcheng Evening News", the mini-program features a theater and a vertically scrolling recommendation feed, with dramas sourced from third-party mini-programs, producers, and authorized distributors. 今年 10 月，微信生态上线了「绿泡泡短剧」免费小程序。据《羊城晚报》此前实测，该小程序有剧场和上下滑动的推荐流，剧集来自第三方小程序、制作方及授权发行方。

item.title: 接近腾讯人士称「裁员 50%」传闻不实，管理层提出两条 AI 转型路线
item.guid: 接近腾讯人士称「裁员-50%」传闻不实，管理层提出两条-AI-转型路线
item.description:
According to a report by Jiemian News on November 12, sources close to Tencent stated that the widely circulated claim of "Tencent laying off 50% of its staff" is false. The sources revealed that Tencent's management discussed accelerating AI-oriented organizational reform during the company's 28th-anniversary Linktime internal live broadcast. 据界面新闻 11 月 12 日报道，接近腾讯的知情人士称，网传「腾讯裁员 50%」的说法不实。消息人士透露，腾讯管理层在公司 28 周年的 Linktime 内部直播中谈到，要加快面向 AI 的组织变革。

Management used "Army" and "Navy" to metaphorically describe two types of tasks: about half of the staff will continue to operate existing core businesses and improve efficiency, while the other half will explore AI-native businesses. The sources believe this statement might be the origin of external misinterpretations. 管理层用「陆军」和「海军」比喻两类任务：约一半人继续经营现有核心业务、提高效率，另一半探索 AI 原生业务。知情人士认为，这一说法可能是外界误读的来源。

According to the source, management also hopes that frontline employees will actively propose new business directions and flatten intermediate management levels to enable teams to respond more quickly. 据该人士转述，管理层还希望一线员工主动提出新业务方向，并压平中间管理层级，让团队能更快响应。

item.title: 百度推出大模型交易平台「词元所」，首月日均调用超 7000 亿词元
item.guid: 百度推出大模型交易平台「词元所」，首月日均调用超-7000-亿词元
item.description:
On November 12, Baidu founder Robin Li officially introduced the large model trading platform "Ciyuan Suo" at the Baidu World Conference. Enterprises and individuals can compare models offered by different suppliers on the platform and purchase the required call quotas. 11 月 12 日，百度创始人李彦宏在百度世界大会上正式介绍大模型交易平台「词元所」。企业和个人可以在平台上比较不同供应商提供的模型，并购买所需的调用额度。

Robin Li likened it to a stock exchange. Before model resources are listed, the platform performs model fingerprint comparison, capability, and availability tests, and continues to monitor service quality after listing. The platform also provides credit ratings for suppliers, sending alerts to users when ratings decline. 李彦宏把它比作证券交易所。模型资源上架前，平台会做模型指纹比对、能力和可用性测试，上架后继续监测服务质量。平台还会给供应商做信用评级，评级下降时向用户发出提醒。

According to Robin Li, Ciyuan Suo connected over 100 model supply resources in its first month online, with an average daily model call volume exceeding 50 million times and an average daily processing of over 700 billion tokens. 据李彦宏披露，词元所上线首月接入了超过 100 项模型供应资源，日均模型调用超过 5000 万次，日均处理的词元超过 7000 亿。

item.title: 张雪：今年已经挣到了「一个小目标」
item.guid: 张雪：今年已经挣到了「一个小目标」
item.description:
On November 11, Zhang Xue Motorcycle's 100,000th complete vehicle rolled off the production line, reaching its year-end production target ahead of schedule. According to Kankan News, the founder Zhang Xue's October performance report, released on social media, showed that the brand sold nearly 5,000 units in a single month, with the four-cylinder sportbike 500RR selling 2,697 units. 11 月 11 日，张雪机车第 10 万台整车下线，提前达到年末生产目标。据看看新闻报道，创始人张雪在社交平台公布的 10 月成绩单显示，品牌单月售出近 5000 台，其中四缸仿赛 500RR 售出 2697 台。

Zhang Xue stated in the video that he has already earned "a small goal" this year. He also set the brand's next goal: to challenge for third place in annual sales. 张雪在视频中称，今年已经挣到了「一个小目标」。他还给品牌定下了下一个目标，冲击年度销量第三。

item.title: Claude 10 月网站访问量增近 24%，增幅超过 ChatGPT 和 Gemini
item.guid: Claude-10-月网站访问量增近-24%，增幅超过-ChatGPT-和-Gemini
item.description:
Claude's website traffic increased by 23.78% month-on-month in October, surpassing OpenAI's ChatGPT and Google's Gemini. Similarweb's global website rankings show that during the same period, ChatGPT grew by 2.15%, and Gemini decreased by 0.15%. Claude 的网站访问量在 10 月环比增长 23.78%，增幅超过 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 和谷歌的 Gemini。Similarweb 的全球网站榜单显示，同期 ChatGPT 增长 2.15%，Gemini 下降 0.15%。

Claude's official website received approximately 1.253 billion visits that month, setting a new record for itself and rising to the 25th position among global websites. According to Forbes, citing Similarweb data, from May to September this year, Claude's monthly website traffic was roughly between 950 million and 1 billion visits. Claude 官网当月获得约 12.53 亿次访问，创自身纪录，升至全球网站第 25 位。据《福布斯》援引 Similarweb 的数据，今年 5 月至 9 月，Claude 每月的网站访问量大致在 9.5 亿至 10 亿次之间。

During the same period, ChatGPT and Gemini's website traffic were approximately 6 billion and 2.64 billion visits, respectively. Similarweb's statistics cover global desktop and mobile web. 同期 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 的网站访问量分别约为 60 亿次和 26.4 亿次。Similarweb 的统计覆盖全球桌面和移动网页。

item.title: 消息称 SpaceX 与特斯拉合并谈判推进，最早 12 月公布协议
item.guid: 消息称-SpaceX-与特斯拉合并谈判推进，最早-12-月公布协议
item.description:
According to Bloomberg on November 12, merger talks between SpaceX and Tesla are progressing. Sources familiar with the matter said the two companies could announce an agreement as early as December this year, and they have also discussed pushing the announcement to early 2027. 据彭博社 11 月 12 日报道，SpaceX 和特斯拉的合并谈判取得进展。知情人士称，两家公司最早可能在今年 12 月宣布协议，也讨论过把公告时间推到 2027 年初。

SpaceX previously disclosed in its quarterly report submitted to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission that its board of directors had established a special committee to evaluate the possibility of a merger with Tesla. Elon Musk stated at SpaceX's earnings call in October that both companies had formed committees composed of independent directors and mentioned cooperation opportunities in chips, robotics, and orbital data centers. SpaceX 此前在提交给美国证券交易委员会的季报中披露，董事会已设立特别委员会，评估与特斯拉合并的可能性。马斯克 10 月在 SpaceX 财报会上表示，两家公司均已成立由独立董事组成的委员会，并提到双方在芯片、机器人和轨道数据中心方面有合作空间。

item.title: 苹果详解 iPhone 18 Pro 隐私提示点，确认亮起后才向系统放行音视频
item.guid: 苹果详解-iPhone-18-Pro-隐私提示点，确认亮起后才向系统放行音视频
item.description:
🔗 security.apple.com/blog/secure-exclaves

Apple's security research team publicly released the design of Secure Exclaves on November 12. Apple stated that in background sensing mode, raw data from cameras and microphones remains in an independent operating environment, and the main system only receives limited information such as recognition results. 苹果安全研究团队 11 月 12 日公开了 Secure Exclaves 的设计。苹果称，在后台感知模式下，摄像头和麦克风的原始数据留在独立的运行环境里，主系统只能收到识别结果等有限信息。

Taking "Hey Siri" on the iPhone 18 Pro as an example, the low-power coprocessor first identifies potential wake words, then hands it over to the isolated environment for secondary confirmation. At this point, the main system only receives the wake signal. After the microphone indicator dot on the screen is checked for color, shape, and display duration, the isolated environment then passes the audio containing the wake word and user request to Siri. 以 iPhone 18 Pro 的「嘿 Siri」为例，低功耗协处理器先识别可能的唤醒词，再交给隔离环境二次确认。此时主系统只会收到唤醒信号。屏幕上的麦克风提示点通过颜色、形状和显示时长检查后，隔离环境才会把包含唤醒词和用户请求的音频交给 Siri。

Apple stated that this architecture is also used for screen privacy prompts on the iPhone 18 Pro Max and iPhone Duo, as well as person recognition in HomeView and camera prompts on the MacBook Neo. 苹果称，这套架构也用于 iPhone 18 Pro Max 和 iPhone Duo 的屏幕隐私提示，以及 HomeView 的人物识别和 MacBook Neo 的摄像头提示。

item.title: 美联航将禁止未经授权的第三方 AI 助手代订机票
item.guid: 美联航将禁止未经授权的第三方-AI-助手代订机票
item.description:
On November 11, local time, United Airlines announced that it would restrict unauthorized third-party personal AI assistants from accessing its booking system. The measures cover United's own digital platforms and will also be enforced through travel agencies and aggregation platforms. United will update its booking, ticketing, and distribution policies. 当地时间 11 月 11 日，美国联合航空宣布，将限制未经授权的第三方个人 AI 助手访问订票系统。措施覆盖美联航自有数字平台，也会通过旅行社和聚合平台执行。美联航将更新预订、出票及分销政策。

United Airlines stated that providing account credentials to personal AI assistants could expose sensitive information, and assistants might also unauthorizedly purchase, modify accounts, or use MileagePlus miles. The airline also cited check-in as an example, where passengers need to personally confirm that there are no prohibited items in their luggage; automating such operations via AI could lead to regulatory compliance issues. 美联航称，向个人 AI 助手提供账户凭据可能暴露敏感信息，助手也可能擅自购买、改动账户或动用 MileagePlus 里程。航司还以值机为例，旅客需要亲自确认行李中没有禁运品，这类操作交由 AI 自动完成可能带来监管合规问题。

item.title: 马斯克回应 Anthropic 算力租约传闻：SpaceX 乐意收回算力
item.guid: 马斯克回应-Anthropic-算力租约传闻：SpaceX-乐意收回算力
item.description:
Regarding the rumor circulating on social platforms that Anthropic might stop leasing computing power from SpaceX by mid-2027, Elon Musk responded on X on November 11 local time, stating that SpaceX would be happy to take back the computing power, but he believes the situation will be the opposite. This rumor originated from a seller's conference transcript circulating on X. 针对社交平台流传的 Anthropic 可能于 2027 年年中停止租用 SpaceX 算力的说法，马斯克当地时间 11 月 11 日在 X 上回应称，SpaceX 乐意收回算力，但他认为情况会相反。这则说法来自一份在 X 上流传的卖方会议转述。

Anthropic disclosed in its prospectus filed on November 10 that the terms of two computing power agreements extend until 2029, with initial non-cancellable periods ending in January and March 2027, respectively. Thereafter, either party may terminate the respective agreement with 90 days' prior written notice. Anthropic 在 11 月 10 日提交的招股文件中披露，两份算力协议的期限延续至 2029 年，初始不可取消期分别于 2027 年 1 月和 3 月结束。此后，双方均可提前 90 天书面通知终止相应协议。

item.title: 前字节、美团招聘负责人魏小康谈 AI 人才泡沫：高薪要看能解决什么问题
item.guid: 前字节、美团招聘负责人魏小康谈-AI-人才泡沫：高薪要看能解决什么问题
item.description:
In an interview with "LatePost," Wei Xiaokang, who previously helped build ByteDance's recruitment system and was responsible for Meituan's recruitment, said that when measuring the compensation of large model talent, one should first look at what problems they can solve. Training foundational models requires a large amount of computing power, and decisions made by a few core researchers can affect the efficiency of training resource utilization, and even determine whether a model can be successfully developed. 在《晚点 LatePost》的访谈中，曾参与搭建字节跳动招聘体系、负责过美团招聘的魏小康说，衡量大模型人才的薪酬，应该先看他们能解决什么问题。基座模型训练需要大量算力，少数核心研究者做的决定，会影响训练资源的使用效率，甚至决定模型能不能做出来。

Wei Xiaokang recalled that the early "hundred-model war" drove up researchers' salaries, with some companies spending high prices to form teams, only for the recruited individuals to be unable to complete large model development. He believes that this type of investment constitutes a talent bubble. As competition for foundational models converges to a few companies, even graduates with top-tier papers and internships at leading model factories may find it harder to secure interview opportunities. 魏小康回忆，早期「百模大战」推高了研究员薪酬，一些公司花高价组队，招来的人却无法完成大模型研发。他认为，这类投入才是人才泡沫。随着基座模型竞争收敛到少数公司，即使有顶级论文和头部模型厂实习经历，毕业生也可能更难拿到面试机会。

When discussing how resource-constrained teams can develop foundational models, Wei Xiaokang offered three approaches: have people who understand models decide the experimental direction, allowing for trial and error while keeping the process verifiable; have algorithm, data, and infrastructure personnel work together; and separately ensure the quality of training data. 谈到资源有限的团队如何把基座做出来，魏小康给出三项做法：由懂模型的人决定实验方向，允许试错但保持过程可检验；让算法、数据和基础设施人员一起工作；单独把训练数据的质量做好。

When it comes to application teams, Wei Xiaokang advocates for shrinking R&D teams, allowing members proficient in using AI to take on a broader range of tasks. He believes that the past method of expanding organizations through extensive recruitment will gradually lose its advantage in AI application startups. 谈到应用团队时，魏小康主张缩小产研团队，让擅长使用 AI 的成员承担更大范围的工作。他认为，过去依靠大量招聘扩大组织的办法，在 AI 应用创业中会逐渐失去优势。

item.title: 奔驰暂停德国工厂新增投资，开始评估关厂选项
item.guid: 奔驰暂停德国工厂新增投资，开始评估关厂选项
item.description:
According to Reuters, Mercedes-Benz management informed employees on November 12 that it would suspend all further investments in its German production sites and thoroughly evaluate options for closing some plants. Negotiations between the company, the works council, and the German metalworkers' union regarding reducing labor costs are still ongoing. 据路透社报道，梅赛德斯-奔驰管理层 11 月 12 日告知员工，将暂停在德国生产基地的所有进一步投资，并详细评估关闭部分工厂的选项。公司与职工委员会、德国金属工业工会就降低用工成本的谈判仍在进行。

Germany's "Tagesschau" (Daily News) cited an interview on Mercedes-Benz's internal network, stating that Michael Schiebe, a board member responsible for production, said that if an agreement cannot be reached, new models will only be produced outside Germany. Britta Seeger, a board member responsible for human resources, stated that management is examining which German sites can continue to operate; negotiations involve working hours, bonuses, and certain collective agreement benefits. 德国《每日新闻》援引奔驰内网采访称，负责生产的董事会成员迈克尔·席贝说，如果双方无法达成协议，新车型将只在德国以外生产。负责人力资源的董事会成员布丽塔·泽格表示，管理层正研究哪些德国基地能够继续维持运营；谈判涉及工时、奖金及部分集体协议福利。

item.title: 微软 365 出现服务故障，Outlook 邮箱和 Teams 连接受影响
item.guid: 微软-365-出现服务故障，Outlook-邮箱和-Teams-连接受影响
item.description:
Microsoft announced on November 12 that some users were unable to connect to multiple Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online mailboxes, Teams, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. The email outage affected connection methods such as Outlook web version and Exchange ActiveSync. 微软 11 月 12 日通报，部分用户无法连接 Microsoft 365 的多项服务，涉及 Exchange Online 邮箱、Teams、SharePoint Online 和 Microsoft 365 Copilot 等。邮箱故障影响的连接方式包括网页版 Outlook 和 Exchange ActiveSync。

Microsoft stated that multiple servers unexpectedly became unavailable, increasing the load on the remaining servers. The team has redirected some connection traffic to other infrastructure and is testing configuration adjustments on a subset of servers, aiming to restore servers that failed automatic health checks. 微软称，多台服务器意外无法提供服务，增加了剩余服务器的负载。团队已将部分连接流量转移到其他基础设施，并在一部分服务器上测试配置调整，目标是恢复未通过自动健康检查的服务器。

item.title: 思科季度营收增长 24%，上调云厂商 AI 基础设施收入预期
item.guid: 思科季度营收增长-24%，上调云厂商-AI-基础设施收入预期
item.description:
Cisco announced its first-quarter fiscal year 2027 results for the period ending October 24. Quarterly revenue was $18.517 billion, a year-over-year increase of 24%; net profit, calculated according to U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), was $4.552 billion. 思科公布截至 10 月 24 日的 2027 财年第一季度业绩。季度营收为 185.17 亿美元，同比增长 24%；按美国通用会计准则（GAAP）计算，净利润为 45.52 亿美元。

Network products were the fastest-growing product group, with revenue of $11.132 billion, a year-over-year increase of 43%. Cisco also raised its fiscal year 2027 AI infrastructure revenue forecast from hyperscale cloud service providers to $9 billion, which is expected to be more than double the actual revenue from this customer group in the previous fiscal year. 网络产品是增长最快的产品组，收入为 111.32 亿美元，同比增长 43%。思科同时将 2027 财年来自超大规模云服务商的 AI 基础设施收入预期上调至 90 亿美元，预计超过上一财年这一客户群实际收入的两倍。

item.title: 应用材料季度营收增长 53%，DRAM 与先进封装业务创纪录
item.guid: 应用材料季度营收增长-53%，DRAM-与先进封装业务创纪录
item.description:
Semiconductor equipment manufacturer Applied Materials announced its fiscal year 2026 results for the period ending October 25: full-year revenue was $34.446 billion, a year-over-year increase of 21%; GAAP net profit was $10.088 billion, a year-over-year increase of 44%. 半导体设备厂商应用材料公布截至 10 月 25 日的 2026 财年业绩：全年营收为 344.46 亿美元，同比增长 21%；GAAP 净利润为 100.88 亿美元，同比增长 44%。

Growth further accelerated in the fourth fiscal quarter: revenue was $10.409 billion, a year-over-year increase of 53%. Applied Materials stated in its earnings call that DRAM and advanced packaging revenues both set company records for the quarter, and its deposition, etch, chemical mechanical planarization (CMP), and process control businesses also reached new revenue highs. The company plans to double its equipment production by 2028 compared to the current fiscal quarter's level. 增长在第四财季进一步加快：营收为 104.09 亿美元，同比增长 53%。应用材料在财报会上表示，当季 DRAM 和先进封装收入均创公司纪录，沉积、刻蚀、化学机械抛光及制程控制业务也达到各自的收入新高。公司计划到 2028 年将设备产量较本财季水平翻倍。

item.title: 💡 李彦宏对话杨元庆：AI 还替代不了 CEO 出差
item.guid: 💡-李彦宏对话杨元庆：AI-还替代不了-CEO-出差
item.description:
At the Baidu World Conference on November 12, Lenovo Group Chairman and CEO Yang Yuanqing, who had just returned from a business trip to Europe and the US, said that AI cannot yet replace him in meeting clients. Discussing the supply chain, Yang Yuanqing gave an example: Lenovo already uses AI to assist in demand forecasting and production scheduling, but demand forecasting is only the first step. How to adjust procurement, production, and supply afterward still requires human judgment. 在 11 月 12 日的百度世界大会上，刚从欧美出差回来的联想集团董事长兼 CEO 杨元庆说，AI 还替代不了他去见客户。谈到供应链，杨元庆举例说，联想已经用 AI 辅助预测需求和安排生产，但需求预测只是第一步。接下来如何调整采购、生产和供应，还需要人来判断。

Baidu founder Robin Li, on the other hand, used his experience with autonomous driving to explain the current stage of embodied AI. He likened current embodied AI to autonomous driving around 2016, and believes that autonomous driving systems require collaborative optimization across chips, cloud, models, and applications. Speaking about Baidu's internal use of AI, he mentioned that in the past, various business units fine-tuned models independently, and once the foundational model was upgraded, previous work quickly became outdated. Baidu later centralized model training to a specialized team. 百度创始人李彦宏则用无人驾驶的经历解释具身智能还处在哪个阶段。他把当前的具身智能比作 2016 年前后的无人驾驶，并认为无人驾驶系统需要芯片、云、模型和应用各层协同优化。谈到百度内部使用 AI，他提到，过去各业务部门自行微调模型，基础模型一升级，先前的工作很快就会落后。百度后来把模型训练集中交给专门团队。

He also gave an example: when agent applications first emerged, Baidu's various business units all wanted to follow the hot trend and develop new applications, which led to fewer resources allocated to each direction. Baidu later scaled back projects simultaneously advanced by various departments through monthly meetings. When Yang Yuanqing discussed Lenovo's approach, he said that the company must first define the boundaries of AI usage, and then encourage employees to experiment in areas such as R&D, sales, and service. 他还举例说，智能体应用刚兴起时，百度各业务部门都想跟着热点做新应用，分到每个方向的资源随之变少。百度后来通过月度会议收缩各部门同时推进的项目。杨元庆谈到联想的做法时说，公司要先划定 AI 的使用边界，再鼓励员工在研发、销售和服务等环节尝试。

item.title: 26.99 万元起，全新腾势 N8 上市，先推出纯电五座版
item.guid: 26.99-万元起，全新腾势-N8-上市，先推出纯电五座版
item.description:
BYD's new Denza N8 was launched on November 12. Six configurations were announced, including four pure electric and two plug-in hybrid models. The pure electric version is priced from 269,900 yuan to 329,900 yuan and will be delivered sequentially starting one week after launch. The plug-in hybrid version is expected to be delivered approximately two months later. 比亚迪旗下全新腾势 N8 于 11 月 12 日上市。本次公布六款配置，包含四款纯电和两款插混。纯电版售价为 26.99 万元至 32.99 万元，将于上市一周后陆续交付。插混版预计晚约两个月交付。

The new N8 features a five-seat layout, while the N8L in the same series has six seats. The new car is equipped with second-generation Blade Batteries and flash charging technology, and features a 30-inch panoramic screen and head-up display system inside. Denza previously announced at its pre-order launch event that the N8 has a front trunk volume of 205L and a regular rear trunk volume of 1046L. 全新 N8 采用五座布局，同系列 N8L 为六座。新车搭载第二代刀片电池和闪充技术，车内配有 30 英寸全景屏和抬头显示系统。腾势此前在预订发布会上公布，N8 的前备厢容积为 205L，后备厢常规容积为 1046L。

item.title: 火山引擎推出 Seedance 2.5 flash，720P 视频约 0.99 元/秒
item.guid: 火山引擎推出-Seedance-2.5-flash，720P-视频约-0.99-元/秒
item.description:
Volcengine launched its video generation model Seedance 2.5 flash on November 12. According to official statements, the new model's generation speed is twice that of Seedance 2.5. Taking 720P text-to-video and image-to-video as examples, the generation price per second is approximately 0.99 yuan, a reduction of about 34% compared to Seedance 2.5. 火山引擎 11 月 12 日推出视频生成模型 Seedance 2.5 flash。按官方口径，新模型的生成速度较 Seedance 2.5 提升一倍。以 720P 的文生视频和图生视频为例，每秒生成价格约 0.99 元，较 Seedance 2.5 降低约 34%。

The new model offers two resolution options, 480P and 720P, and can generate videos up to 30 seconds long per segment. For a single generation, it can take up to 10 images, 5 video clips, and 5 audio clips as references. Volcanic Engine used the same set of prompts to have both models generate a telescope advertisement, with the Flash version more completely presenting a series of actions from raising the telescope to lowering it and responding with a smile. 新模型提供 480P 和 720P 两档分辨率，单段最长可生成 30 秒视频。一次生成最多可输入 10 张图片、5 段视频和 5 段音频作为参考。火山引擎用同一组提示词让两款模型分别生成望远镜广告，flash 版更完整地呈现了从举起望远镜到放下并微笑回应的一连串动作。

Volcanic Engine announced that the new model will be successively launched on Jiemeng, LibTV, Updream, Creao AI, and TapNow starting November 12, and its API will be available on Volcanic Ark on November 15. 火山引擎称，新模型自 11 月 12 日起陆续登陆即梦、LibTV、Updream、Creao AI 和 TapNow，API 将于 11 月 15 日上线火山方舟。

item.title: 豆包工作接入 Kimi、GLM 和 DeepSeek，选模型时可查看额度倍率
item.guid: 豆包工作接入-Kimi、GLM-和-DeepSeek，选模型时可查看额度倍率
item.description:
Doubao Work announced on November 12 that it has integrated third-party models such as Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM 5.3, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. The platform had previously opened third-party models to enterprise customers, and this update expands the range of models users can choose from. 豆包工作 11 月 12 日宣布接入 Kimi K3.1 Pro、GLM 5.3 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 等第三方模型。此前平台已向企业客户开放第三方模型，此次更新扩大了用户可以自行选择的模型范围。

Doubao Work indicates the quota consumption multiplier on the model selection page. Users can switch between self-developed and third-party models on the same interface and view the relative quota consumption for the same task under different models. Doubao 2.1 Lite and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash currently have temporary reduced multipliers as a promotion. 豆包工作在模型选择页标出了额度消耗倍率。用户可以在同一界面切换自研和第三方模型，并查看同一任务在不同模型下的相对额度消耗。豆包 2.1 Lite 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 已有临时下调倍率的优惠。

Doubao also plans to offer quota discounts for participating models during specified hours on weekdays and holidays. New users who log in to the desktop version of Doubao Work can receive a free 30-day subscription. 豆包还计划在工作日和节假日的指定时段，对参与活动的模型提供额度优惠。新用户登录豆包工作电脑版，可免费领取 30 天订阅权益。

item.title: 百度开放两款文心应用模型 API，现场演示 116 秒生成动画
item.guid: 百度开放两款文心应用模型-API，现场演示-116-秒生成动画
item.description:
On November 12, Baidu released the Wenxin Lightning Deep Thinking Model and Wenxin Yijing Micro-expression Large Model at the Baidu World Conference. Both models have been launched on Baidu AI Cloud Qianfan Platform, offering APIs to enterprise customers and partners. 11 月 12 日，百度在百度世界大会上发布文心闪电深度思考模型和文心一镜微表情大模型。两款模型均已上线百度智能云千帆平台，向企业客户和合作伙伴开放 API。

Among them, Wenxin Lightning previously primarily served Baidu Search, capable of understanding complex demands and invoking tools. Baidu plans to add visual and voice input in subsequent versions. Wenxin Yijing is designed for digital human videos, capable of generating videos from long texts or driving digital humans based on long audio segments. 其中，文心闪电此前主要服务百度搜索，可以理解复杂需求并调用工具。百度计划在后续版本加入视觉和语音输入。文心一镜面向数字人视频，可用长文本生成视频，也可根据长段语音驱动数字人。

Sun Tianxiang, head of Baidu's foundational model R&D, made his first public appearance at the conference and demonstrated new uses for the Wenxin 5.5 Flash preview version. According to a live report from Zhidx.com, the model used Python to write a 116-second 2D short film, depicting a white pelican riding a bicycle through 20 different art styles. 百度基础模型研发负责人孙天祥在会上首次公开亮相，并演示了文心 5.5 Flash 预览版的新用法。据智东西现场报道，模型用 Python 编写了一部 116 秒的二维短片，画面里一只白鹈鹕骑自行车穿过 20 种不同的艺术风格。

item.title: 红果短剧上线 AI 虚拟角色权属登记
item.guid: 红果短剧上线-AI-虚拟角色权属登记
item.description:
According to Sina Tech, the Hongguo Short Drama Creator Center recently launched AI drama virtual character creation and rights confirmation functions. Creators can submit materials such as real person portrait authorization, upstream IP authorization, or copyright registration certificates for virtual characters before publishing their works. 据新浪科技报道，红果短剧创作者中心近日上线 AI 剧虚拟形象创编与确权功能。创作者可以在作品发布前，为虚拟角色提交真人肖像授权、上游 IP 授权或著作权登记证书等材料。

Hongguo will review virtual characters and their materials, and upon approval, generate a record of ownership for future use of the character or dispute resolution. The Southern Metropolis Daily learned from the Hongguo Short Drama Creator Center that the platform has also released guidelines for virtual character creation and rights confirmation for comic dramas, applicable to real person portraits, IP adaptations, and original characters. 红果会审核虚拟形象及其材料，通过后生成一份权属记录，供后续使用角色或处理纠纷时查阅。《南方都市报》从红果短剧创作者中心了解到，平台也发布了面向漫剧的虚拟形象创建与确权指引，适用于真人肖像、IP 改编和原创角色。

item.title: 三星与 Google 合作的 Gemini 眼镜开启预订，12 月 10 日上市
item.guid: 三星与-Google-合作的-Gemini-眼镜开启预订，12-月-10-日上市
item.description:
Samsung announced that its smart glasses, developed in collaboration with Google, are now available for pre-order and will be released on December 10. Both the Warby Parker and Gentle Monster series will be sold in the United States, with the Gentle Monster series also launching in South Korea. In the US market, the Warby Parker series starts at $395, and the Gentle Monster series ranges from $449 to $489. 三星宣布，与 Google 合作开发的智能眼镜已开放预订，12 月 10 日上市。Warby Parker 和 Gentle Monster 两个系列均在美国销售，Gentle Monster 系列也会在韩国上市。美国市场 Warby Parker 系列 395 美元起，Gentle Monster 系列售价为 449 美元至 489 美元。

The glasses are equipped with a 12-megapixel camera, open-ear speakers, and four microphones. Users can ask Gemini about objects in front of them, listen to navigation instructions, or reply to messages. When taking photos or videos, an indicator light on the outside of the frame will illuminate; if the indicator light is blocked or malfunctions, the camera's shooting function will be disabled. 眼镜搭载 1200 万像素摄像头、开放式扬声器和四颗麦克风。用户可通过 Gemini 询问眼前物体、听取导航指令或回复消息。拍照或录像时，镜框外侧指示灯会亮起，指示灯被遮挡或故障时，相机拍摄功能会被禁用。

Samsung lists compatible devices including certain Galaxy phones running One UI 9 or newer, Pixel 7 series and later models running Android 17 with system updates from September 2026 or newer installed, and iPhone 13 and later models running iOS 26.6 or newer with at least 6GB of RAM. Bixby is only available when paired with a Galaxy phone. 三星列出的兼容设备包括运行 One UI 9 或更新系统的部分 Galaxy 手机、运行 Android 17 且已安装 2026 年 9 月或更新版本系统更新的 Pixel 7 系列及后续机型，以及运行 iOS 26.6 或更新系统、至少配备 6GB 内存的 iPhone 13 及后续机型。Bixby 仅在配对 Galaxy 手机时可用。

item.title: 双 11 部分热门游戏本比 618 更贵，涨价传导到整机
item.guid: 双-11-部分热门游戏本比-618-更贵，涨价传导到整机
item.description:
Jiemian News reported on November 12 that after stacking promotions, the average transaction price of some popular gaming laptops during this year's Double 11 was still higher than during 618. Taking the transaction records from the Dewu App cited in the report as an example, the average price of the Mechanical Revolution Jiaolong 16 Pro gaming laptop on the platform rose from 6224.08 yuan during 618 to 8348 yuan just before Double 11. 界面新闻 11 月 12 日报道，今年双 11 部分热门游戏本叠加促销后，成交均价仍比 618 高。以报道援引的得物 App 交易记录为例，机械革命蛟龙 16 Pro 游戏本的站内均价从 618 期间的 6224.08 元升至双 11 前夕的 8348 元。

On the same platform, the average transaction prices of Lenovo Rescuer R7000P and HP Omen 11 both increased by nearly 30% during Double 11 compared to 618. Digital product dealers interviewed by Jiemian News stated that some customers postponed their device upgrades after inquiring about prices. 同一平台上，联想拯救者 R7000P 和惠普暗影精灵 11 的双 11 成交均价较 618 都上涨近三成。界面新闻采访的数码经销商称，一些顾客询价后推迟了换机。

Cost pressure has already been reflected in materials. TrendForce cited a mainstream-priced laptop as an example, where the combined proportion of processor, memory, and solid-state drive in the material cost rose to about 68% in the third quarter of 2026. TrendForce pointed out that brands can respond to this round of cost increases by raising prices, compressing profits, or adjusting storage specifications. 成本压力已经反映在物料上。集邦咨询以一款主流价位笔记本为例，处理器、内存和固态硬盘合计占物料成本的比重，在 2026 年第三季度升至约 68%。集邦指出，品牌可以通过涨价、压缩利润或调整存储规格来应对这轮成本上升。

item.title: 洛图科技：三季度 iPad 在国内主流电商平台销量下滑 45.2%
item.guid: 洛图科技：三季度-iPad-在国内主流电商平台销量下滑-45.2%
item.description:
Jiemian News cited monitoring data from Lotu Technology, stating that in the third quarter of 2026, iPad sales on mainstream e-commerce platforms in China fell by 45.2% year-on-year, and its sales share dropped to 19.1%. Apple remained the top-selling tablet brand on these platforms during that quarter. 界面新闻援引洛图科技的监测数据称，2026 年第三季度，iPad 在国内主流电商平台的销量同比下滑 45.2%，销量份额降至 19.1%。苹果仍是该季度这些平台上销售额最高的平板品牌。

Lotu Technology listed Apple's price increase for iPads at the end of June as one of the reasons for the sales decline. According to Jiemian News, an authorized Apple specialty store also confirmed that it had adjusted prices in line with the official changes. Looking at all domestic channels, a total of 6.361 million consumer smart tablets were sold in the third quarter, a year-on-year decrease of 20.1%. 洛图科技把苹果 6 月底上调 iPad 价格列为销量下滑的原因之一。据界面新闻报道，一家苹果授权专营店也确认已经随官方调整售价。放眼国内全渠道，第三季度消费级智能平板共售出 636.1 万台，同比下降 20.1%。

item.title: 电影《收获日出》定档 11 月 20 日，内地同步北美上映
item.guid: 电影《收获日出》定档-11-月-20-日，内地同步北美上映
item.description:
The new "Hunger Games" film, "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping," is confirmed to be released in mainland China on November 20, the same day as North America. The new film is adapted from Suzanne Collins' novel of the same name and directed by Francis Lawrence, who has previously directed multiple films in the series. 《饥饿游戏》新片《饥饿游戏：收获日出》确认于 11 月 20 日在中国内地上映，与北美同日。新片改编自苏珊·柯林斯的同名小说，由此前多次执导该系列的弗朗西斯·劳伦斯执导。

The story goes back to before Katniss participated in the Hunger Games, telling how her later mentor Haymitch entered the arena representing District 12 in his youth. This was the second Quarter Quell, with the number of tributes doubled. Joseph Zada plays young Haymitch, and Ralph Fiennes plays President Snow. 故事回到凯特尼斯参加饥饿游戏之前，讲述她后来的导师黑密斯如何在少年时期代表第 12 区进入竞技场。这一届是第二届世纪极限赛，参赛人数翻倍。约瑟夫·扎达饰演少年黑密斯，拉尔夫·费因斯饰演斯诺总统。

item.title: 皮克斯发布《猫的威尼斯奇旅》正式预告，《海底总动员》新短片将贴片放映
item.guid: 皮克斯发布《猫的威尼斯奇旅》正式预告，《海底总动员》新短片将贴片放映
item.description:
Disney and Pixar released the official trailer and new poster for "The Cat's Venetian Adventure" on November 12. The film, directed by Enrico Casarosa, director of "Luca," tells the story of Nero, a black cat with only one life left, who owes a debt to the local cat gang leader and meets street musician Maya in Venice. 迪士尼与皮克斯 11 月 12 日发布《猫的威尼斯奇旅》正式预告和新海报。电影由《夏日友晴天》导演埃里康·卡萨罗萨执导，讲述只剩最后一条命的黑猫尼罗，欠下当地猫帮头目的债，在威尼斯结识街头音乐家玛娅。

Mark Ruffalo and Laurence Fishburne voice Nero and the cat gang leader, respectively. Newly announced voice actors include John Turturro, Isabella Rossellini, and Jason Schwartzman. The film will be released in North America on March 5, 2027, and will also feature a new short film, "Loving Dory," set in the "Finding Nemo" universe, with Ellen DeGeneres returning to voice Dory. 马克·鲁法洛和劳伦斯·菲什伯恩分别为尼罗和猫帮头目配音。新公布的配音演员包括约翰·特托罗、伊莎贝拉·罗西里尼和杰森·施瓦茨曼。电影将于 2027 年 3 月 5 日在北美上映，届时还将贴片放映《海底总动员》世界观的新短片《Loving Dory》，艾伦·德杰尼勒斯回归为多莉配音。

item.title: 《降世神通》续作《Avatar：Seven Havens》第二季定档明年 5 月
item.guid: 《降世神通》续作《Avatar：Seven-Havens》第二季定档明年-5-月
item.description:
According to Inverse, Paramount+ announced that the second season of the animated series "Avatar: Seven Havens" will premiere on May 21, 2027, with the third season launching later the same year. 据 Inverse 报道，Paramount+ 宣布动画《Avatar: Seven Havens》第二季将于 2027 年 5 月 21 日上线，第三季也将在同年稍晚上线。

The story continues the world of "Avatar: The Last Airbender" and "The Legend of Korra," starring twin sisters Pavvi and Nisha. Co-creator Michael Dante DiMartino said in an interview that the first season focuses on how the two sisters grow up together, while the second season will have them embark on their own journeys and face different responsibilities. 故事延续《降世神通：最后的气宗》和《科拉传奇》的世界观，主角是双胞胎帕薇和妮莎。联合创作者迈克尔·但丁·迪马蒂诺在采访中说，第一季写两姐妹如何一起成长，第二季将让她们各自踏上旅程，面对不同的责任。
